The '''Stouker concussion rifle''' was a ranged weapon built from scratch by the vicious [[Sissk]], who used it as their primary weapon.

==Description==
While the Sissk had their own term for the weapon, outsiders dubbed it the "Stouker concussion rifle" after its primary component, a concussion chamber made by the [[Stouker]] company.

Powered by [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]], it fired bullets of ionized air which exploded in shock waves. Each concussive blast consumed 4 cells.<ref name="Dark Forces Manual: Coded Transmissions">''[[Dark Forces Manual: Coded Transmissions]]''</ref> The rifle had a range of up to thirty [[Meter/Legends|meters]], and the resulting explosion about four meters in diameter, with enough force to send an average human flying a short distance. It also possessed a secondary firing mode, the blast from which was less devastating in terms of radius, but had a greater impact on the target, as well as a rather noticeable recoil&mdash;sufficient to push an ordinary humanoid two or three steps backward with each shot.

The weapon's inability to be blocked by a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and the splash damage from the primary firing mode, made this one of the more effective weapons against [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], although a skilled Jedi (such as, possibly, [[Jaden Korr]]) could redirect a concussive blast in the general direction of its origin with a well-timed [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force Push]].

==History==
The device became somewhat of a trademark of the Sissk gangs due to its unconventional construction, but by the end of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] it had become widely adopted across the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] by various military forces, most notably the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].

[[Hazard stormtrooper]]s of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] were known to wield these weapons. [[Rax Joris]], an Imperial officer in command of an outpost on [[Dosuun]], also used one.

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
There is an inconsistency in the game mechanics of ''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]'' in the usage and effectiveness of the rifle; the player/Kyle Katarn is wounded whenever a rifle hits nearby and thus can not use it in close range, but this is not true for the enemy Trandoshan sprites who can fire in close range, giving them a big advantage.<ref name="Dark Forces Official Player's Guide">''[[Dark Forces Official Player's Guide]]''</ref>

In ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]'', the Stouker concussion rifle was rarely effective against Force-using enemies in the single-player story mode as, apparently, all such foes were exceptionally skilled in Force pushing incoming explosive projectiles of all kinds&mdash;including concussion shots&mdash;back toward the player, even if the player moved after firing. This same tactic also applies to the [[PLX-2M portable missile launcher]].
